exposure: Type of anesthesia in cesarean section (spinal anesthesia vs. general anesthesia)
outcome: Umbilical vein blood gas analysis (pH, pO2, SaO2)
cohort: 172 term neonates delivered by cesarean section
finding: Neonates born by cesarean section with spinal anesthesia had significantly higher Apgar scores, higher umbilical vein pH, and lower pO2 and SaO2 levels compared to those born by cesarean section with general anesthesia.
mod_finding: Neonates born by cesarean section with spinal anesthesia had significantly higher Apgar scores, higher umbilical vein pH, and lower pO2 and SaO2 levels compared to those born by cesarean section with general anesthesia.
